# Asset Fidelity Checklist: Asset Delivery Fidelity

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of identity-integrity and preview-layout requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required components of the approved Glitchpad full lockup identified strongly enough to distinguish a complete mark from the observed fold-fragment failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every black and white vector master and derived raster size rather than only the visible website examples? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are preview requirements defined for guideline examples and asset-library cards across every production asset category? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the preview media region, presentation surface, artwork boundary, and metadata divider each defined as distinct measurable entities? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK005 Is the permitted monochrome color transformation distinguished unambiguously from prohibited geometry, source, and composition changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Are full-mark and reduced-mark requirements consistent with the prohibition against substituting reduced geometry in a full lockup? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the shared preview contract stated consistently for wide, tall, square, transparent, and opaque assets? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 through §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the exact-delivery preview requirement consistent with the prohibition against per-page substitution or reconstructed artwork? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Can complete monochrome lockup structure be objectively measured without relying only on subjective visual comparison? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Are containment boundaries and centering tolerances quantified for automated acceptance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is byte-identity scope explicit enough to separate frozen canonical geometry, regenerated corrective lockups, and presentation-only asset stability? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Are completion signals defined for production kits, public routes, accessibility, themes, and responsive widths? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements present for transparent assets whose visibility depends on a declared preview surface? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements present for baked backgrounds, shadows, long metadata, wrapped titles, and extreme aspect ratios that could cross the divider? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are both defect classes covered by explicit negative scenarios that fail before publication? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]

## Dependencies and Scope

- [ ] CHK016 Is the dependency on existing approved Glitchpad geometry documented without implying authorization to change identity design? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Are #163, #164, release work, and unrelated delivery naming changes explicitly excluded to prevent scope drift? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- The installed prerequisite helper currently requires `plan.md` even though autopilot orders checklist before plan; the checklist was generated from the validated active specification and canonical checklist template.
